roleHelp.admin: Full access, including users and panel settings.
roleHelp.operator: Views the system status and panel settings.
roleHelp.auditor: Views the system status, panel settings and the audit log.

create.title: New user
create.intro: The person signs in with this name and password and can change the password in their own settings.
create.usernameHint: 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, “.”, “_” and “-”, starting with a letter.

role.title: Change the role of {username}
role.hint: Changing the role closes the terminals {username} has open.

password.title: Set a new password for {username}
password.hint: {username} will be signed out of all sessions, and their open terminals are closed.

disable.title: Disable {username}?
disable.content: {username} will be signed out, their open terminals are closed, and they cannot sign in until the account is enabled again.

resetTotp.title: Reset two-step verification for {username}?
resetTotp.content: {username} will be able to sign in with the password alone and can set up two-step verification again.

delete.title: Delete {username}?
delete.content: The account is deleted permanently, signed out everywhere and its open terminals are closed. Its entries in the audit log are kept.
